description: Generated from the Go config types by `go generate ./internal/panel/config`; do not edit. The reference is docs/panel.md.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema the file follows, for editors: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfhayn/clauductor/main/docs/panel.schema.json`. The panel ignores it. `clauductor panel init` writes it.

alerts.description: Alert thresholds (see *Alerts*). A missing key takes the default; `0` turns that alert off.

approval_wait_hours.description: A change's proposal with no `**Approved:**` line, waiting longer than this since it was last written, raises an approval alert (see *Needs you from the metrics*).

context_pct.description: A context window at or above this percentage raises a context alert.

five_hour_pct.description: The 5-hour quota at or above this percentage raises a quota alert (block at 100%).

idle_minutes.description: A live session idle longer than this raises an idle alert.

min_interval_seconds.description: At most one notification per lane per interval.

notify.description: Send macOS notifications for the alerts that interrupt.

stale_days.description: A lane on a branch of its own with no commit for this many days (counted from its start while it has none of its own) raises a stale alert.

waiting_seconds.description: A permission prompt, MCP elicitation or input request older than this raises a waiting alert.

base.description: What a new lane's branch starts from. `git fetch` runs first; if it fails, the lane still starts and the page says so.

cards.description: Commands whose output renders as a card in the Activity drawer (see *Card output*).

command.description: argv, run in the project root **without a shell**. Use `["sh", "-c", "..."]` if you want one. 30-second timeout.

pin.description: Also show the card in the side panel, as a tab of the pinned cards' box: below the selected lane's details, or alone while no lane is selected. Each output line is a title that opens to the rest of the line (see *Pinned cards*).

refresh.description: `"watch:<relpath>"`: re-run when that file (or a direct entry of that directory) changes; the path must stay inside the project. `"interval:<seconds>"`: re-run on a timer (minimum 5 s). Every card also runs at start and on ↻ REFRESH.

host_names.description: Extra names the panel answers to, each `<label>.localhost` in lower case (for example `"myproject.localhost"`). `clauductor.localhost` always works. No wildcards.

lane_types.description: Launch options per lane type, passed as `claude --model <m> --effort <e>`.

lanes.description: A rule ending in `/` is a prefix (`"feature/"` matches `feature/add-x`, shown as `add-x`). A rule ending in `*` is a prefix without the star (`"feature/spike-*"`). Any other rule matches one branch exactly (`"main"`). The longest matching rule wins. An unmatched branch is `other`; a detached HEAD is `detached`.

lanes_auto_close.description: `"on_merge"` closes a lane once its branch's pull request merges, as **Close lane** would, and only when claude is idle, the worktree clean and the pull request merged at the branch's tip; otherwise Needs you asks "PR merged: close lane?" (see *Close a lane when its PR merges*).

metrics.description: The project's metrics for the **Metrics** view and the Flow card (see *Metrics*). Without it the panel still shows what it computes itself: merge frequency and PR cycle time from `gh`, and spend from the status line.

card.description: Show the **Flow** card in the side panel while there are metrics to show; `false` keeps them in the Metrics view alone.

command.description: argv, run in the project root **without a shell**, like a card's, only while the config is trusted. 30-second timeout, 1 MB of output. Its stdout is the metrics JSON (see *Metrics*); a payload that breaks the contract shows its error in the view.

refresh.description: When to re-run the command, as a card's `refresh`. It also runs at start and on **Refresh**. Needs `metrics.command`.

name.description: Shown in the status bar and in notification titles. One line of plain text, at most 80 characters, not blank and not starting with `-`.

ports.description: Gives each lane a stable port of its own: `base`, `base + per_lane`, … kept in the lane registry, exported to the lane as `CLAUDUCTOR_PORT` and shown in its header.

per_lane.description: The step between two lanes' ports, 1 to 100 (a lane may use the ports up to the next one).

queues.description: Shared resources held as a lease on disk (see *Queue and the gate lock protocol*).

command.description: Optional argv that **Run in `<lane>`** (a lane's Gate tab) starts through `lock-run` in that lane's worktree. It runs only when you press it.

lock.description: The lease directory, relative to the **git common dir** (so every worktree agrees), e.g. `"clauductor/gate.lock"`. No `..`, not absolute.

quota_auto_resume.description: Once the 5-hour window resets, type `quota_resume_line` into each lane the usage limit stopped, once per reset, only while claude is idle and waits on no permission (see *Resume after the 5-hour reset*).

quota_economy.description: Economy mode (see *Economy mode*): off unless set. Read from the default project's config, since the quota is the machine's.

five_hour_pct.description: At or above this 5-hour quota the panel writes `~/.clauductor/panel/economy.json` with `"economy": true` and shows an **economy** badge by the quota; it turns off once the quota is 3 points below. `0` is off.

quota_guard.description: Refuses to start or restore a lane at or above a 5-hour quota (see *Quota guard*).

five_hour_pct.description: Refuse at or above this 5-hour quota, unless the dialog's override is ticked. `0` turns it off.

quota_resume_line.description: The line `quota_auto_resume` types. One line of plain text, at most 200 characters.

templates.description: Lane recipes offered by **New lane** (see *Lane templates*).

branch_pattern.description: The new branch, with `{name}` (required) and `{issue}`, e.g. `"feature/{name}"`. Empty means the lane type's prefix + `{name}`; a lane type with no prefix rule needs one.

first_prompt.description: ONE line typed into claude once it is ready. `{name}` and `{issue}` only; no newline or control character; at most 4000 characters.

lane_type.description: One of the config's lane types (a value of `lanes`, or a key of `lane_types`).

suggest.description: What this template could start next: a command whose output **New lane** lists under the template, each row filling in the lane name (see *Suggestions*).

command.description: argv, run in the project root **without a shell**, like a card's, only while the config is trusted. 30-second timeout.

refresh.description: When to re-run it, as a card's `refresh`: `"watch:<relpath>"` or `"interval:<seconds>"`.

tmux_socket.description: The panel's own tmux server (`tmux -L <name>`). Lanes never mix with your own tmux sessions.

version.description: The config version the file is written for. It may use only the keys of that version or an earlier one; a key from a later version is an error that names the key and the version it needs. Without it the file is read as the latest version, and the panel says so once at start.

worktree_dir.description: Where a new lane's worktree is created: relative to the project root and inside it, or absolute.

worktree_setup.description: A command run in a new lane's new worktree before claude starts (see *Worktree setup, teardown and ports*).

command.description: argv, run **without a shell** in the worktree, only while the config is trusted, with `CLAUDUCTOR_LANE` and `CLAUDUCTOR_PORT` set. 5-minute timeout.

worktree_teardown.description: A command run in a lane's worktree before **Close lane** removes it.

command.description: argv, as `worktree_setup.command`. If it fails, or leaves the worktree changed, the worktree stays.

title: clauductor panel config (.clauductor/panel.json)
